verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any registrable webhooks, outbound HTTP callbacks, or event-stream subscription for sign-ups, sign-ins, or user changes. The homepage activity-feed mockup ("created a session", "updated profile") and the 'Security & observability' marketing line describe an activity display, not a subscribable event delivery mechanism, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to webhooks or event streams for auth events (sign-ups, sign-ins, user changes) to keep my systems in sync
